{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes 'revenue' contain commas? {has_commas}")

# Check for the special QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")"}
